create_class_Rotate: create a Rotate augmentation class that rotates images and masks by a random angle within a given range
create_class_Resize: create a Resize augmentation class that resizes images and masks to a random or fixed size ratio
create_class_Crop: create a Crop augmentation class that randomly crops images and masks to a specified size range
create_class_Perspective: create a Perspective augmentation class that applies perspective distortion to images and masks
create_class_CropResizePad: create a CropResizePad augmentation class that resizes, crops, and pads images and masks back to original dimensions
